description: The author names the archetype for the new service.
STEGO writes a declaration scaffold and a folder for fills.
The author checks the scaffold and starts editing it.
The agent names the archetype it is writing for.
STEGO reports that archetype's components, the settings each one declares, and the slots each one declares.
The agent writes only what that report allows.
The author asks STEGO to check the declaration.
STEGO decodes the declaration strictly and checks every invariant against the registry.
STEGO reports every fault it found, or reports that the declaration is acceptable.
The agent reads the refusal.
The agent changes the declaration at the place each fault names.
The agent asks STEGO to check the declaration again.
The service author runs apply.
STEGO writes the record beside the generated output.
The service author commits the record together with the generated code.
The platform engineer names the component digest and the checkouts to search.
STEGO reads the record in each checkout.
STEGO reports every service that used that digest, and every checkout it could not read.
The platform engineer checks a service's record against its generated files.
STEGO compares each recorded file hash with the file in the repo.
STEGO reports every file that no longer matches, and every input the record names that the state does not hold.
The platform engineer changes one component and publishes its new digest.
The platform engineer records the new digest as the successor of the old one, with the date the old one stops working.
A consumer takes the fix by moving that component's pin.
The service author runs validate or plan.
STEGO compares each pinned digest against the registry's supersession records.
STEGO reports each superseded pin with its successor and its date.
The service author moves the component's pin to the successor digest.
The service author runs apply.
The service author reads the diff and commits the generated change with its record.
The platform engineer records the digest as withdrawn, with the date it stops working.
STEGO reports every recorded service that pins it.
After the date, validate fails for every service that still pins it.
The platform engineer names the commit to qualify.
STEGO verifies the compiler checks and the signed artifact runs at that commit.
STEGO authenticates the published release through the consumer path and cross-checks each asset digest.
The operator asks for a named release.
The installer verifies the artifact signature and digest.
The installer puts the binary in place and reports the build identity it installed.
